sliceagent.review:
Issues found in `taskq`:

- `taskq/queue.py`: `__init__` uses mutable default argument `items=[]`, so separate queues share the same underlying list.
- `taskq/queue.py`: `is_full` checks `len(self._items) > self.capacity` instead of `>=`, allowing the queue to grow one item past `capacity`.
- `taskq/worker.py`: `run_once` opens the log file but never closes it, leaking file descriptors.
- `taskq/worker.py`: `run_once` silently swallows all exceptions and returns `None`, hiding handler failures.
- `taskq/scheduler.py`: `run_with_retry` never increments `attempts`, so a failing task causes an infinite loop instead of stopping after `max_retries`.
- `taskq/scheduler.py`: `should_retry` is unused by `run_with_retry` and its `attempt` parameter semantics are inconsistent with the class’s actual retry logic.
- `taskq/store.py`: `find_by_name` builds SQL via `"... WHERE name = '%s'" % name`, making it vulnerable to SQL injection.
